import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    g = params[0] - params[1]*np.exp(-params[2]*t) + params[3]*t*np.exp(-params[4]*t)
    h = params[5] + params[6]*np.exp(-params[7]*t) + params[8]*t*np.exp(-params[9]*t)
    return g + h*A**3
